verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25139184 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318529 dated 2025-07-09. It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD each: 9,000 pcs for 2025-08-07 and 10,000 pcs for 2025-08-12. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The delivery terms text is internally inconsistent.
red_flags: Delivery terms contradict each other: EXW Boise is stated and DDP 'is not agreed', yet freight, insurance and duties are said to be prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer would normally arrange and pay these, so this means extra charges on the invoice.
The confirmation has no document date.

The order confirms two lines of the same material (CMP-GAM-002) on different dates, 9,000 plus 10,000, which is 19,000 pcs in total. The document does not state the ordered quantity, so it cannot be checked against the PO here.
The unit of measure for quantities is not stated.
observations: Clean, machine-printed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
No corrections or strike-throughs are visible.
The description text wraps across three lines in the table.
The document has no issue date; 2025-07-09 is the date of the customer's order.
